# PostKit

> Portable article components, Markdown tooling, link metadata resolvers, and framework adapters.

PostKit separates a structured publishing contract from its React, Next.js, React Router, TanStack Router, and Astro renderers.

## Start here

- [Getting started](/docs/getting-started): Install PostKit, mount its provider, and render a first portable article component.
- [Choosing a package](/docs/choosing-a-package): Match each PostKit package to the rendering environment and integration boundary it owns.

## Concepts

- [Core concepts](/docs/core-concepts): Understand the content contract, renderers, host responsibilities, and resolver boundaries.

## Authoring

- [Components](/docs/components): Learn how PostKit components, declarations, props, and presentation variants work together.
- [Markdown and MDX](/docs/markdown-and-mdx): Author PostKit declarations in MDX or literal-only plain Markdown directives.

## Integration

- [Theming](/docs/theming): Layer PostKit recipes over a Chakra system while preserving the host application's design tokens.
- [Framework guides](/docs/framework-guides): Connect the portable component map to Next.js, React Router, TanStack Router, or Astro.

## Services

- [Unfurling and oEmbed](/docs/unfurling): Resolve URLs behind a server boundary and render normalized link or social metadata.

## Reference

- [API reference](/docs/api-reference): Browse generated TypeScript exports or consume the same API model as structured JSON.
- [Compatibility and environments](/docs/compatibility): Check framework, runtime, rendering, module, and hydration support before integrating PostKit.
- [Security and trust boundaries](/docs/security): Keep credentials, remote fetching, embed markup, authored URLs, and host callbacks inside explicit trust boundaries.

## Help

- [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting): Diagnose provider, theme, routing, hydration, directive, and remote metadata integration issues.

## Packages

- [@postkit/unfurl](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/unfurl): Provider-neutral link metadata resolution for Postkit
- [@postkit/react](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/react): Chakra-based React components and Markdown tooling for articles
- [@postkit/shiki](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/shiki): A lazy Shiki syntax-highlighting adapter for Postkit and Chakra CodeBlock
- [@postkit/next](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/next): Postkit MDX components and link routing for Next.js
- [@postkit/react-router](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/react-router): Postkit MDX components and link routing for React Router
- [@postkit/tanstack-router](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/tanstack-router): Postkit MDX components and link routing for TanStack Router
- [@postkit/astro](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/astro): Postkit components and Markdown integration for Astro

## Machine-readable reference

- [Component manifest](https://unpkg.com/@postkit/react/component-manifest.json): Versioned component names, props, examples, runtime requirements, and renderer support.
- [TypeScript API model](/api/postkit-api.json): TypeDoc JSON generated from every public package export.
- [Full documentation context](/llms-full.txt): Guides and package documentation in one text document.
- [Documentation index](/postkit-docs.json): Structured guide metadata and content.
